description: Ministry of Agriculture - Order made to declare the Lists of approved General Pesticides, Domestic Pesticides and Restricted Pesticides
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order under Section 9 of the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, declaring specific pesticides as approved and classifying them as general pesticides. It represents regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for pesticide control.
